page.overview:
What is Lev Polosku?

The Lev Polosku, or Striped Lion, was a feline animal native to the Union of Progressive Peoples mining planet Shānmén. When exposed to a mutagenic pathogen, the Lev Polosku would transform into a creature known as the "Alion".
